title: Accessible compact metrics: focus grid announcer and locale-aware scrubber prototype review
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Compact metric cards and the cost scrubber in the Console currently have two accessibility gaps discovered during the last usability pass: (1) keyboard focus moves between tiles in a way that is hard to follow with a screen reader and doesn't preserve spatial grid semantics; (2) the timeline scrubber formats numbers inconsistently across locales and does not announce locale-aware units when dragged. Goal: Deliver a reviewed prototype and developer-ready handoff that resolves focus grid semantics, provides an announcer for grid focus changes, and makes the timeline scrubber locale-aware and accessible for keyboard-only and screen-reader users. Acceptance criteria:
- Keyboard focus follows a logical 2D grid order with arrow-key navigation (Left/Right/Up/Down) and Tab order preserved for linear flows.
- Visually visible focus rings meet contrast and WCAG 2.1 AA color thresholds for focus and selected states.
- Screen reader announces: "Card X of Y, metric name, short summary" on focus and reads delta and unit localized to the user's locale (e.g., "€12.3M" vs "12,3 M€" depending on locale conventions).
- Scrubber drag announces start/end percentages and localized units at reasonable debounce (250ms) to avoid announcement spam.
- RTL layouts tested for swap of horizontal navigation and number directionality.
- Design tokens and color keys documented for engineering; PR includes accessible token variants for high-contrast theme.
comments: 2026-02-25 - Aisha Patel: Initial discovery session with PM (Jonas Meyer) and Accessibility SME (Dr. Elena Morales). Confirmed two priority gaps: focus grid semantics and scrubber i18n announcements. Logged technical spike for kv cache interactions causing focus loss (ENG-21844).

2026-02-28 - Riley Chen: Uploaded first interactive prototype to Figma and linked InVision flow. Included arrow-key navigation variants (linear, row-major, column-major) for testing. Requested design review from 3 screen reader testers.

2026-03-02 - Accessibility review (Dr. Elena Morales): Prefer row-major navigation for dense dashboards; add an aria-live polite region for scrubber announcements with 250ms debounce; recommended announcing cardinal position (e.g., 'column 2 of 4').

2026-03-04 - Design QA: Color token iteration 3 ensures focus shadow and border meet 4.5:1 contrast against all background states. Attached token list and snippet to Confluence page. Requested engineering estimate for token exposure (ENG-21901).

2026-03-06 - Engineering sync (Riley + ENG lead): Agreed on implementation approach: use roving tabindex + explicit aria-posinset/aria-setsize for grid semantics; implement aria-live on scrubber with localized string templates passed from client locale utils. ENG will add automated E2E keyboard tests.

2026-03-08 - PM feedback (Jonas Meyer): Ensure metrics microcopy includes unit fallback when locale lacks currency symbol placement metadata. Also requested a small A/B to measure error rate on keyboard navigation in rollouts dashboard. Added 'instrumentation' label.

2026-03-09 - Usability test results: 6 of 8 participants completed hover+keyboard tasks without confusion; two participants using JAWS requested more explicit 'selected' announcement when card has focus and expanded details. Updated prototype to include 'selected' state announcement and clearer focus outline.

2026-03-10 - Review comments: Design review board approved prototype pending final engineering checklist: 1) E2E keyboard tests passing in CI, 2) i18n formatting using locale CLDR utils, 3) rollbacks for scrubber announcement frequency under heavy load. Created follow-up ENG tickets.

ENG: Add aria-live polite region with 250ms debounce for scrubber announcements; integrate locale formatting util (ENG-21903).
DES: Finalize and publish color token mapping + dark/high-contrast variants to the shared token library (design-tokens v2).
PM: Schedule A/B instrumentation for rollouts view to track keyboard navigation success rate (PM-447).
QA: Create automated keyboard E2E tests for both LTR and RTL locales, run in CI matrix.
